$comment: Every wallpaper on the site comes from this file. Add a theme, a device or a wallpaper here, then run: python3 tools/build.py

themes.name: Officina
themes.description: Twelve 1-bit engravings in the style of the portfolio, one per accent colour. Each one pairs its own planet with a building from antiquity, floating solids and a cloud bank.

howto: Tap Landscape or Portrait, then hold the image and choose Save to Photos.
In Safari, open a new tab, tap Edit at the bottom of the start page and turn on Background Image.
Tap + and pick the wallpaper.

themes.name: Shan Shui
themes.description: Layer after layer of mountain ridges that fade into fog, in the manner of Chinese landscape painting. Each one has its own sky, paper tone and sun or moon.

howto: Tap Landscape or Portrait, then hold the image and choose Save to Photos.
In Safari, open a new tab, tap Edit at the bottom of the start page and turn on Background Image.
Tap + and pick the wallpaper.

themes.name: Suminagashi
themes.description: Rings of ink dropped onto still water and stirred with a breath, then lifted onto paper. The Japanese marbling technique is older than the European one.

howto: Tap Landscape or Portrait, then hold the image and choose Save to Photos.
In Safari, open a new tab, tap Edit at the bottom of the start page and turn on Background Image.
Tap + and pick the wallpaper.

themes.name: Terrazzo
themes.description: Broken marble, granite and glass set in a cement binder and ground smooth, the flooring of Venetian palazzi and Italian railway stations.

howto: Tap Landscape or Portrait, then hold the image and choose Save to Photos.
In Safari, open a new tab, tap Edit at the bottom of the start page and turn on Background Image.
Tap + and pick the wallpaper.

themes.name: Seigaiha
themes.tagline: Blue ocean waves, row on row
themes.description: Rows of overlapping concentric arcs, a wave pattern known in Japan since the Heian period. Some carry a moon or a fading tide.

howto: Tap Landscape or Portrait, then hold the image and choose Save to Photos.
In Safari, open a new tab, tap Edit at the bottom of the start page and turn on Background Image.
Tap + and pick the wallpaper.

themes.name: Azulejo
themes.description: Glazed ceramic tiles with a painted motif that joins up across the grout, as on the facades of Lisbon and Porto. Each set has its own motif and glaze.

howto: Tap Landscape or Portrait, then hold the image and choose Save to Photos.
In Safari, open a new tab, tap Edit at the bottom of the start page and turn on Background Image.
Tap + and pick the wallpaper.

themes.name: Art Deco
themes.description: Thin metal lines on deep lacquer: scalloped fans, rising suns and stepped towers, the ornament of 1920s cinemas, liners and lobbies.

howto: Tap Landscape or Portrait, then hold the image and choose Save to Photos.
In Safari, open a new tab, tap Edit at the bottom of the start page and turn on Background Image.
Tap + and pick the wallpaper.

themes.name: Memphis
themes.description: Squiggles, confetti triangles, dot grids and zigzags with heavy black outlines, after the design collective that shocked Milan in 1981.

howto: Tap Landscape or Portrait, then hold the image and choose Save to Photos.
In Safari, open a new tab, tap Edit at the bottom of the start page and turn on Background Image.
Tap + and pick the wallpaper.

themes.name: Topographic
themes.tagline: Contour lines of places that do not exist
themes.description: Contour lines of invented islands, ridges and valleys, drawn like a survey map with every fifth line heavier. Some sheets tint the land by height.

howto: Tap Landscape or Portrait, then hold the image and choose Save to Photos.
In Safari, open a new tab, tap Edit at the bottom of the start page and turn on Background Image.
Tap + and pick the wallpaper.

themes.name: Tessellae
themes.description: Patterns from Roman villa floors, laid stone by stone: meanders, rosettes, running waves and stars, in marble, terracotta and slate with grey mortar between.

howto: Tap Landscape or Portrait, then hold the image and choose Save to Photos.
In Safari, open a new tab, tap Edit at the bottom of the start page and turn on Background Image.
Tap + and pick the wallpaper.

themes.name: Neon Noir
themes.tagline: Rain, towers and neon at night
themes.description: A city skyline at night in the rain: towers with lit windows, glowing signs and the whole scene mirrored in the wet street below.

howto: Tap Landscape or Portrait, then hold the image and choose Save to Photos.
In Safari, open a new tab, tap Edit at the bottom of the start page and turn on Background Image.
Tap + and pick the wallpaper.
